text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I borrow...? I've read 
that book before... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I've never seen this book before... But I 
should've read everything in the Carrot 
Bunko collection...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
C-Could that be... the one that just came 
out recently...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Amazing, it's already in stock...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No... Maybe I'll read j-just a little 
bit...

And just like that, Rice Shower completely 
lost track of time and was absorbed in 
reading, neglecting her training in the 
process...
